text:
Nia C: MeridianPay needs a compliance bundle to move forward with POC sign-off. They asked for: SOC 2 Type II executive summary, ISO 27001 certificate page, a signed pen-test attestation (single page), and a short mapping doc between controls and our product features. Also asked: can logs be kept in EU for the POC?

Omar P: We can share SOC2 exec summary + cert page openly. Full SOC2 report or raw vuln findings require NDA + dataroom. Pen-test attestation: we have a templated attestation signed by Security.

Leah S: Procurement also wants to know whether producing those artifacts changes billing or requires a legal addendum. Can finance weigh in?

Devon M: Short answer: docs-only -> no change. If they request dataroom access or raw findings review we apply a one-time audit-support fee and need legal signoff. If they require customer-managed KMS for logs, that's Private/Dedicated only and triggers a separate quote.

Nia C: MeridianPay says their compliance team needs the signed PDF (not just a signature image). @Omar can you get the signed file?

Omar P: Yes. I'll route the attestation to CISO for signature. Expect scanned PDF within 24 hours.

LegalBot: Reminder: include a redaction cover note explaining what is redacted and why. If they request raw findings we must issue an NDA link and a ticket to #assurance for dataroom provisioning.

InfraOps: For their external scan we can provide ephemeral staging IPs and a presign command. Example: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-meridian/poc/meridian-scan.zip --expires-in 3600``` Use the poc prefix and set lifecycle to 14d.

Leah S: Also, MeridianPay is pushing on EU residency for logs/KV cache. For hosted POC we can only guarantee region pin for Dedicated/Private. We'll need to surface that as a blocker if they insist.

Nia C: Action items: (1) Omar to get signed pen-test attestation PDF; (2) Security to prepare SOC2 exec summary + cover note; (3) InfraOps to provision presigned URL and IP window; (4) Finance to confirm audit-support fee policy if dataroom is requested; (5) Sales to confirm whether Meridian signs our standard NDA.

Devon M: ETA: presigned URL + IP window by EOD today, signed attestation and SOC2 exec summary by EOD tomorrow pending approvals.

Leah S: I'll draft a one-page controls mapping table (encryption, keys, logging, network segmentation) and attach it to the zip. That usually satisfies procurement.

Nia C: Great. I'll compile everything into a single zip and send via secure share. If they push for CMK in the POC, escalate to AE for pricing & timeline. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
